title: RPC: Test harness
description:
Implement RPC layer test harness from docs/plans/13-rpc-layer-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: Full test harness doc — P1-P5 (protocol), F1-F5 (fault injection), O1-O3 (observability), S1-S3 (stress), B1-B4 (benchmarks), ST1-ST3 (soak), SEC1-SEC4 (security)

Key deliverables:
- Protocol tests: round-trip correctness for all RPC methods, streaming message ordering, error code mapping, SnapshotID propagation end-to-end
- Fault injection: network partition simulation, server crash during stream, client disconnect mid-call, timeout propagation across RPC boundary
- Observability: metric emission verification, trace context propagation, log correlation
- Stress tests: concurrent RPC calls, rapid connect/disconnect, large payload handling
- Benchmarks: RPC latency per method, streaming throughput, connection setup time
- Soak tests: long-running stream stability, memory growth under sustained load
- Security tests: auth token validation, TLS enforcement, request size limits, injection prevention
- Integration tests using real ConnectRPC client/server with mock SandboxHostService

Depends on: RPC layer core implementation task.
